SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Are you listening to me, Onii-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh? Oh, of course.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Onii-san, that was really mean of you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh? What was?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: You know what I mean.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...I was waiting here all alone, you know.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sorry.

Yeah, I did leave her behind. And as a result, she 
had to wait by herself, all alone...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Do you really regret it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I do. I won't leave you behind again.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Can I really trust you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...But Kanako was still here with you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
You know her. Did you really think she would 
obediently stay put if she saw a chance to escape?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I didn't think you would let her...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: And just what do you mean by that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, well... You know, just a figure of speech...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Oh, well. It's fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Geez, I even went and bought a new swimsuit...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Speaking of which, Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That swimsuit looks great on you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Wha-- ...W-Where did that come from?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
W-What was I supposed to do? I didn't get the 
chance to say it earlier.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: That might be so, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Does it really look good on me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, it's undeniably cute.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hm? Did you say something?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I-It's nothing!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Um, Ayase-san, why do you seem so angry?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Put your hand over your heart and think about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Even if you say that...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [font_size=17]...Geez, you're so dense.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: But in the end, you just had to chase after Kirino...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah, you never know what she's up to, so I went 
after her.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...So, you abandoned me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, I was just like, going with the flow...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: If...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
If I had started running the other way, would you 
have chased after me instead?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Of course. I would have definitely come chasing 
after you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Even if that meant ignoring Kirino?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well, after I've caught up with you, I might go 
after her again.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...I really don't know. I can't decide that before I'm 
actually in that situation.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...I see.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Ehehe~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ayase?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: In that case, I'll just have to come along with you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Thanks, that's reassuring.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Let's worry about Kirino later. Why don't we go 
have some fun now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah. We're at the beach, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Oh, right. Before that...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...I see how it is.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: A-Ayase?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I knew it. Onii-san, Kirino still comes first to you...
